summary: Tested new IR-13 annual report feature. Backend: 14/14 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified working - Tabs component, year selector, IR-13 download button.
critical_code_review_comments: IR-13 endpoint correctly aggregates all monthly payroll entries by employee for annual totals
Available-years endpoint uses MongoDB aggregation pipeline to get distinct years with period counts
create_ir13_report function generates Excel with 3 sheets: Detalle Anual, Resumen Mensual, Declaración
Frontend Tabs component properly switches between Monthly and Annual views
Year selector auto-selects most recent year and shows period count
IR-13 download button correctly enables when year is selected
seed_data_creation: Used existing payroll periods from previous tests (5 periods for year 2026)
context_for_next_testing_agent: IR-13 annual report feature fully tested. Key findings: 1) GET /api/payroll-v2/available-years returns array of {year, periods_count} sorted descending, 2) GET /api/payroll-v2/annual-report/ir13/{year} generates valid XLS file with 3 sheets, 3) Frontend DGIIReportsPage has Tabs component with 'Reportes Mensuales' and 'Reporte Anual' tabs, 4) Year selector fetches from available-years endpoint and auto-selects most recent year, 5) IR-13 download button enables when year is selected.

available_years_endpoint.details: GET /api/payroll-v2/available-years returns array with year and periods_count, sorted descending

ir13_export_endpoint.details: GET /api/payroll-v2/annual-report/ir13/{year} returns valid XLS with 3 sheets

ir13_auth_required.details: Both endpoints require authentication, return 401/403 without token

ir13_404_handling.details: Returns 404 for years with no payroll data

dgii_reports_page_tabs.details: Tabs component shows Monthly and Annual tabs, switching works correctly

year_selector_ui.details: Year selector shows available years with period counts, auto-selects most recent

ir13_download_button.details: Download button enables when year is selected, disabled otherwise

ir13_sheets: IR-13 Detalle Anual - Employee-level annual totals with ISR, AFP, SFS
Resumen Mensual - Monthly breakdown of retentions for all 12 months
Declaración - Summary declaration form for DGII submission

mocked_integrations.all_apis: REAL - No mocked APIs, all endpoints are real
